title: Tenali Rama and the Two Thieves

scenes.summary: Two thieves plan to rob Tenali.
scenes.text: Two thieves decided to rob Tenali Rama’s house at night.
scenes.image_prompt: two thieves planning robbery at night cartoon style

scenes.summary: Tenali prepares a fake pot of gold.
scenes.text: Tenali filled a pot with stones and pretended it was full of gold.
scenes.image_prompt: Tenali filling pot with stones and covering it cartoon

scenes.summary: The thieves hear the plan and follow it.
scenes.text: The thieves heard Tenali and waited for him to throw the pot into the river.
scenes.image_prompt: thieves hiding and listening near house cartoon

scenes.summary: The thieves search in the river.
scenes.text: The thieves jumped into the river and searched all night for the pot.
scenes.image_prompt: thieves diving in river searching cartoon

scenes.text: Tenali laughed as the thieves realized they were tricked and ran away.
scenes.image_prompt: Tenali laughing while thieves run away cartoon

story: Tenali tricked two thieves by pretending to throw a pot of gold into a river. The thieves searched all night but found only stones. In the morning, Tenali laughed as they ran away.
